name: continuity
description: Durable project state across AI sessions: decisions, constraints, and rejected paths, versioned in git as plain markdown. Not a memory tool — it answers what is true about the project now, and what must not change.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts src/mcp.ts src/hook-session-start.ts src/hook-stop-capture.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run build && bash test/smoke.sh && bash test/reconcile.sh && bash test/risks.sh && bash test/resolve.sh && bash test/schema.sh && bash test/budget.sh
